Class OnlineMapService

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.OnlineMapService
public class OnlineMapService extends Object
Online Data Fetching Service for real planetary satellite datasets (Earth, Moon, Mars, Venus, Mercury). Connects to USGS Astrogeology WMS, NASA GIBS, and OpenTopography endpoints. Caches retrieved datasets locally under ~/.ether/cache/maps/ for offline reusability. Supports both UI-oriented JavaFX Image and headless BufferedImage async pipelines.
Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
